label: 1. How are you finding the Outpost?

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: How are you finding the Outpost?

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Well, I could care less what you think. It's going to be your home for the foreseeable future regardless.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: You can take advantage of the fact that the Ark has no jurisdiction over there.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Commanders typically don't fraternize with the Nikkes unless they're on a mission. But things are different at the Outpost.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: After getting close to the Nikkes,

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: you'll find it's easier to look after them.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: So don't think of it as a bad thing.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: You know what they say, when life gives you lemons, make lemonade!
